verses.original: γὰρ Οἴδαμεν ὅτι ἐὰν τοῦ ἐπίγειος σκήνους ἡ ἡμῶν οἰκία καταλυθῇ ἔχομεν οἰκοδομὴν ἐκ Θεοῦ αἰώνιον οἰκίαν ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ἀχειροποίητον
verses.transliteration: gar Oidamen hoti ean tou epigeios skēnous hē hēmōn oikia katalythē echomen oikodomēn ek Theou aiōnion oikian en tois ouranois acheiropoiēton
verses.literal: For we know that if the earthly tent - we [live in] is dismantled we have a building from God an eternal house in - heaven not built by human hands

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ ἐν τούτῳ στενάζομεν ἐπιποθοῦντες ἐπενδύσασθαι ἡμῶν τὸ ἐξ οὐρανοῦ τὸ οἰκητήριον
verses.transliteration: kai gar en toutō stenazomen epipothountes ependysasthai hēmōn to ex ouranou to oikētērion
verses.literal: - For in this [tent] we groan longing to be clothed with our vvv vvv heavenly - dwelling

verses.original: εἴ γε καὶ ἐνδυσάμενοι οὐ εὑρεθησόμεθα γυμνοὶ
verses.transliteration: ei ge kai endysamenoi ou heurethēsometha gymnoi
verses.literal: because . . . . . . when we are clothed vvv we will not be found naked

verses.original: καὶ γὰρ οἱ ὄντες ἐν τῷ σκήνει στενάζομεν βαρούμενοι ἐφ’ ᾧ οὐ θέλομεν ἐκδύσασθαι ἀλλ’ ἐπενδύσασθαι ἵνα τὸ θνητὸν καταποθῇ ὑπὸ τῆς ζωῆς
verses.transliteration: kai gar hoi ontes en tō skēnei stenazomen baroumenoi eph’ hō ou thelomen ekdysasthai all’ ependysasthai hina to thnēton katapothē hypo tēs zōēs
verses.literal: For . . . - [while] we are in [this] tent we groan under our burdens because . . . vvv we do not wish to be unclothed but clothed so that [our] mortality may be swallowed up by - life

verses.original: δὲ Θεός ὁ κατεργασάμενος ἡμᾶς εἰς τοῦτο αὐτὸ ὁ δοὺς ἡμῖν τὸν τοῦ Πνεύματος ἀρραβῶνα
verses.transliteration: de Theos ho katergasamenos hēmas eis touto auto ho dous hēmin ton tou Pneumatos arrabōna
verses.literal: And [it is] God who has prepared us for this very [purpose] - [and] has given us - the Spirit as a pledge of what is to come

verses.original: οὖν πάντοτε Θαρροῦντες καὶ εἰδότες ὅτι ἐνδημοῦντες ἐν τῷ σώματι ἐκδημοῦμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: oun pantote Tharrountes kai eidotes hoti endēmountes en tō sōmati ekdēmoumen apo tou Kyriou
verses.literal: Therefore vvv we are always confident although we know that while we are at home in the body we are away from the Lord

verses.original: γὰρ περιπατοῦμεν διὰ πίστεως οὐ διὰ εἴδους
verses.transliteration: gar peripatoumen dia pisteōs ou dia eidous
verses.literal: For we walk by faith not by sight

verses.original: Θαρροῦμεν δὲ καὶ εὐδοκοῦμεν μᾶλλον ἐκδημῆσαι ἐκ τοῦ σώματος καὶ ἐνδημῆσαι πρὸς τὸν Κύριον
verses.transliteration: Tharroumen de kai eudokoumen mallon ekdēmēsai ek tou sōmatos kai endēmēsai pros ton Kyrion
verses.literal: We are confident then and would prefer . . . to be away from the body and at home with the Lord

verses.original: διὸ καὶ φιλοτιμούμεθα εἶναι εὐάρεστοι αὐτῷ εἴτε ἐνδημοῦντες εἴτε ἐκδημοῦντες
verses.transliteration: dio kai philotimoumetha einai euarestoi autō eite endēmountes eite ekdēmountes
verses.literal: So - we aspire to please Him whether we are at home [in this body] or away from it

verses.original: γὰρ τοὺς ἡμᾶς δεῖ πάντας φανερωθῆναι ἔμπροσθεν τοῦ βήματος τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα ἕκαστος κομίσηται τὰ πρὸς ἃ ἔπραξεν διὰ τοῦ σώματος εἴτε ἀγαθὸν εἴτε φαῦλον
verses.transliteration: gar tous hēmas dei pantas phanerōthēnai emprosthen tou bēmatos tou Christou hina hekastos komisētai ta pros ha epraxen dia tou sōmatos eite agathon eite phaulon
verses.literal: For - we must all appear before the judgment seat - of Christ that each one may receive his due - for the things done in the body whether good or bad

verses.original: οὖν Εἰδότες τὸν φόβον τοῦ Κυρίου πείθομεν ἀνθρώπους δὲ πεφανερώμεθα Θεῷ δὲ ἐλπίζω πεφανερῶσθαι ἐν ὑμῶν ταῖς συνειδήσεσιν καὶ
verses.transliteration: oun Eidotes ton phobon tou Kyriou peithomen anthrōpous de pephanerōmetha Theō de elpizō pephanerōsthai en hymōn tais syneidēsesin kai
verses.literal: Therefore since we know [what it means] to fear the Lord we try to persuade men - What we are is clear to God and I hope it is clear to your - conscience as well

verses.original: οὐ συνιστάνομεν ἑαυτοὺς ὑμῖν πάλιν ἀλλὰ διδόντες ὑμῖν ἀφορμὴν καυχήματος ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἵνα ἔχητε πρὸς τοὺς καυχωμένους ἐν προσώπῳ καὶ μὴ ἐν καρδίᾳ
verses.transliteration: ou synistanomen heautous hymin palin alla didontes hymin aphormēn kauchēmatos hyper hēmōn hina echēte pros tous kauchōmenous en prosōpō kai mē en kardia
verses.literal: vvv We are not commending ourselves to you again Instead we are giving you an occasion to be proud of us so that you can answer . . . those who take pride in appearances [rather than] . . . in [the] heart

verses.original: Εἴτε γὰρ ἐξέστημεν Θεῷ εἴτε σωφρονοῦμεν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: Eite gar exestēmen Theō eite sōphronoumen hymin
verses.literal: If - we are out of our mind [it is] for God if we are of sound mind [it is] for you

verses.original: γὰρ τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἡ ἀγάπη συνέχει ἡμᾶς κρίναντας τοῦτο ὅτι εἷς ἀπέθανεν ὑπὲρ πάντων ἄρα οἱ πάντες ἀπέθανον
verses.transliteration: gar tou Christou hē agapē synechei hēmas krinantas touto hoti heis apethanen hyper pantōn ara hoi pantes apethanon
verses.literal: For - Christ’s - love compels us [because] we are convinced . . . that One died for all therefore - all died

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέθανεν ὑπὲρ πάντων ἵνα οἱ ζῶντες μηκέτι ζῶσιν ἑαυτοῖς ἀλλὰ τῷ ἀποθανόντι ὑπὲρ αὐτῶν καὶ ἐγερθέντι
verses.transliteration: kai apethanen hyper pantōn hina hoi zōntes mēketi zōsin heautois alla tō apothanonti hyper autōn kai egerthenti
verses.literal: And He died for all that those who live {should} no longer live for themselves but for Him [who] died for them and was raised again

verses.original: Ὥστε ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἡμεῖς οἴδαμεν οὐδένα κατὰ σάρκα καὶ εἰ ἐγνώκαμεν Χριστόν κατὰ σάρκα ἀλλὰ νῦν γινώσκομεν οὐκέτι
verses.transliteration: Hōste apo tou nyn hēmeis oidamen oudena kata sarka kai ei egnōkamen Christon kata sarka alla nyn ginōskomen ouketi
verses.literal: So from - now on we regard no one according to [the] flesh vvv Although we once regarded Christ [in this way] . . . - - [we do so] no longer

verses.original: ὥστε εἴ τις ἐν Χριστῷ καινὴ κτίσις τὰ ἀρχαῖα παρῆλθεν ἰδοὺ καινά γέγονεν
verses.transliteration: hōste ei tis en Christō kainē ktisis ta archaia parēlthen idou kaina gegonen
verses.literal: Therefore if anyone [is] in Christ [he is] a new creation The old has passed away Behold [the] new has come

verses.original: δὲ πάντα Τὰ ἐκ τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ καταλλάξαντος ἡμᾶς ἑαυτῷ διὰ Χριστοῦ καὶ δόντος ἡμῖν τὴν διακονίαν τῆς καταλλαγῆς
verses.transliteration: de panta Ta ek tou Theou tou katallaxantos hēmas heautō dia Christou kai dontos hēmin tēn diakonian tēs katallagēs
verses.literal: - All this [is] - from - God who reconciled us to Himself through Christ and gave us the ministry - of reconciliation

verses.original: ὡς ὅτι Θεὸς ἦν καταλλάσσων κόσμον ἑαυτῷ ἐν Χριστῷ μὴ λογιζόμενος αὐτῶν τὰ παραπτώματα αὐτοῖς καὶ θέμενος ἐν ἡμῖν τὸν λόγον τῆς καταλλαγῆς
verses.transliteration: hōs hoti Theos ēn katallassōn kosmon heautō en Christō mē logizomenos autōn ta paraptōmata autois kai themenos en hēmin ton logon tēs katallagēs
verses.literal: - that God was reconciling [the] world to Himself in Christ not counting [men’s] - trespasses against them And He has committed to us the message - of reconciliation

verses.original: οὖν πρεσβεύομεν Ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ ὡς τοῦ Θεοῦ παρακαλοῦντος δι’ ἡμῶν δεόμεθα ὑπὲρ Χριστοῦ καταλλάγητε τῷ Θεῷ
verses.transliteration: oun presbeuomen Hyper Christou hōs tou Theou parakalountos di’ hēmōn deometha hyper Christou katallagēte tō Theō
verses.literal: Therefore we are ambassadors for Christ as though - God were making His appeal through us We implore you on behalf of Christ Be reconciled - to God

verses.original: ἐποίησεν τὸν γνόντα μὴ ἁμαρτίαν ἁμαρτίαν ὑπὲρ ἡμῶν ἵνα ἐν αὐτῷ ἡμεῖς γενώμεθα δικαιοσύνη Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: epoiēsen ton gnonta mē hamartian hamartian hyper hēmōn hina en autō hēmeis genōmetha dikaiosynē Theou
verses.literal: [God] made Him who knew no sin [to be] sin vvv on our behalf so that in Him we might become [the] righteousness of God
